invariant: Argument-redaction edits require a literal hyphen option prefix in the scanned text. The routine returns no value and cannot add a redaction without such a token.
reasoning: All option redaction paths in _redactar_comando are anchored to --password=, --user=, --proxy-user=, -p, -u/-U or a short flag cluster; each requires a hyphen in the same substring.
Inherited program context alone never redacts a bare positional token; parent option-value masking still runs for quoted values.
Double-quote escape normalization can introduce quote/dollar/backtick/control placeholders, never a hyphen.
PEM, API-token, bearer, sensitive assignment and quoted key/value redaction remain outside this shortcut and still execute.
The portable backup is byte-identical under the existing declared-copy guard, and both paths retain their corpus.
